Definition: Peor, a mountain East of Jordan; Baal Peor, (for a deity worshipped there
BiblicalUsage: Peor = "cleft"; n pr loc; 1) a mountain peak in Moab belonging to the Abarim range and near Pisgah; n pr deity; 2) a false god worshipped in Moab; corresponds to Baal
